description: This file defines a class 'TritonEmbeddingConfig' for handling the transformation, validation, and processing of embedding requests and responses for a Triton-based endpoint within the litellm project. It includes methods for mapping parameters, transforming requests/responses, and error handling specific to Triton embeddings.

classes.name: TritonEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for transforming and handling Triton embedding requests and responses, including parameter mapping, validation, and response processing.

methods.description: Transforms input data into the Triton request format with detailed shape and datatype information.
